"""Rein mechanische Dokumentpruefung und Handoffserialisierung.

Kein Schema wird erzeugt, geladen, kompiliert oder gegen Daten ausgewertet.
Keine Fallinputs, Oracles, Produktmodule oder Weltzustandsauswertung.
"""
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
import json
import sys
from source_inventory import ROOT, OWN, load, digest, record, snapshot, compare, write_new

STRUCTURAL = {'properties', 'items', 'allOf', 'if', 'then', 'else'}
SCHEMA_ROOT_KEYWORDS = {'$schema', '$id', '$ref', '$defs', 'type', 'properties', 'items', 'allOf',
                        'anyOf', 'oneOf', 'if', 'then', 'else', 'not', 'required', 'additionalProperties'}
OUTPUTS = {'README.md', 'field-normalform-event.json', 'mechanical-checks.json', 'handoff.json',
           'mechanics/source_inventory.py', 'mechanics/document_nodes.py',
           'mechanics/check_documents.py', 'mechanics/source-before.json'}
SOURCE_SCHEMA = 'history/contracts/v1/ereignis.schema.json'


def strict_pairs(items):
    result = {}
    for key, value in items:
        assert key not in result, ('Doppelter Dokumentschluessel', key)
        result[key] = value
    return result


def reject_constant(value):
    raise AssertionError(('Nichtendliche JSON-Konstante im Dokument', value))


def strict_load(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8'), object_pairs_hook=strict_pairs, parse_constant=reject_constant)


def pointer(obj, ptr):
    assert ptr == '' or ptr.startswith('/')
    for token in ptr.split('/')[1:]:
        token = token.replace('~1', '/').replace('~0', '~')
        obj = obj[int(token)] if isinstance(obj, list) else obj[token]
    return obj


def canonical(value):
    return digest(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8'))


def inventory():
    found = sorted(p.relative_to(OWN).as_posix() for p in OWN.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
    assert set(found) <= OUTPUTS | {'brief.md'}, ('Fremde Datei im eigenen Ordner', found)
    return found


def owned_record(relative):
    raw = (OWN / relative).read_bytes()
    return {'path': relative, 'absolutePath': (OWN / relative).as_posix(), 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': digest(raw)}


def collect_history(obj, ptr='', required=False, result=None):
    result = {} if result is None else result
    children = []
    result[ptr] = {'local': {k: v for k, v in obj.items() if k not in STRUCTURAL},
                   'required': required, 'children': children}
    for name, value in obj.get('properties', {}).items():
        p = ptr + '/properties/' + name.replace('~', '~0').replace('/', '~1')
        children.append(p)
        collect_history(value, p, name in obj.get('required', []), result)
    if 'items' in obj:
        children.append(ptr + '/items')
        collect_history(obj['items'], ptr + '/items', True, result)
    for i, value in enumerate(obj.get('allOf', [])):
        p = ptr + '/allOf/' + str(i)
        children.append(p)
        collect_history(value, p, False, result)
    for name in ('if', 'then', 'else'):
        if name in obj:
            children.append(ptr + '/' + name)
            collect_history(obj[name], ptr + '/' + name, False, result)
    return result


def validate_documents():
    # Hier bedeutet validieren ausschliesslich Dokumentadressierung/Identitaet.
    d = strict_load(OWN / 'field-normalform-event.json')
    fields = strict_load(ROOT / 'contract-fields.json')
    history = strict_load(ROOT / SOURCE_SCHEMA)
    assert not (set(d) & SCHEMA_ROOT_KEYWORDS), 'Dokumentwurzel enthaelt Schemaschluessel'
    assert d['documentOnly'] and not d['implementationAuthorized']
    assert d['wholeManifestVerdict'] == 'NOT_ISSUED' and d['status'] == 'INCOMPLETE'
    assert not d['foreignReviewPerformed'] and not d['schemaGenerationOrValidationAuthorized']
    selected = {x['schemaPointer']: (i, x) for i, x in enumerate(fields['baseNodes']) if x['contract'] == 'ereignis'}
    adds = [(i, x) for i, x in enumerate(fields['additionalFields']) if x['contract'] == 'ereignis']
    indexed_history = collect_history(history)
    assert set(indexed_history) == set(selected)
    nodes = d['nodes']
    by_ptr = {x['proposedV2Pointer']: x for x in nodes}
    by_id = {x['nodeId']: x for x in nodes}
    assert len(by_ptr) == len(nodes) == len(by_id)
    assert all(x['contract'] == 'ereignis' for x in nodes)
    assert all(x['nodeId'] == 'ereignis#' + x['proposedV2Pointer'] for x in nodes)
    assert all('*' not in x['proposedV2Pointer'] for x in nodes)
    assert all(x['proposedV2Resource'] == 'produkt/vertraege/v2/ereignis.schema.json' for x in nodes)
    mapped = [x['historicalSchemaPointer'] for x in nodes if x['historicalSchemaPointer'] is not None]
    assert len(mapped) == len(set(mapped)) == len(selected)
    assert set(mapped) == set(selected)
    expected_additions = {
        '/properties/candidate/properties/factCatalog': 0,
        '/properties/candidate/properties/contentDigest': 1,
        '/properties/candidate/properties/ruleDigest': 2,
        '/allOf/14/then/properties/payload/properties/evidenceIds': 3,
        '/allOf/14/then/properties/payload/properties/evidenceIds/items': 3,
    }
    assert {i for i, _ in adds} == {0, 1, 2, 3}
    assert {x['proposedV2Pointer'] for x in nodes if x['decision'] == 'ADD'} == set(expected_additions)
    expected_replaced = {'', '/properties/schemaVersion', '/properties/seq',
                         '/properties/monotonic/properties/ns', '/properties/candidate',
                         '/allOf/12/then/properties/payload/properties/sinceSeq',
                         '/allOf/14/then/properties/payload',
                         '/allOf/14/then/properties/payload/properties/eventIds'}
    assert {x['proposedV2Pointer'] for x in nodes if x['decision'] == 'REPLACE'} == expected_replaced
    preserved = {'localConstraints': 0, 'enums': 0, 'typesExceptDeclaredNs': 0,
                 'constsExceptDeclaredVersion': 0, 'closedObjects': 0, 'stringRules': 0,
                 'arrayRules': 0, 'inlineNotFragments': 0, 'historicalChildLists': 0}
    for p, (i, src) in selected.items():
        row = by_ptr[p]
        old = src['constraints']
        new = row['newConstraints']
        assert row['historicalSchemaPointer'] == p
        assert indexed_history[p]['local'] == old == row['oldConstraints']
        assert indexed_history[p]['required'] == src['requiredInParent'] == row['origin']['requiredInParentLiteral']
        assert row['oldPresence']['requiredInImmediateSchemaObject'] == src['requiredInParent']
        assert row['origin']['fieldTable']['jsonPointer'] == '/baseNodes/' + str(i)
        assert row['origin']['baseRecordCanonicalSha256'] == canonical(src)
        assert row['origin']['historicalNodeCanonicalSha256'] == canonical(pointer(history, p))
        assert row['origin']['historicalSchema']['jsonPointer'] == p
        assert row['origin']['historicalSchema']['sha256'] == digest((ROOT / SOURCE_SCHEMA).read_bytes())
        assert row['oldStructuralLinks']['childNodeIds'] == ['ereignis#' + q for q in indexed_history[p]['children']]
        preserved['historicalChildLists'] += 1
        if row['decision'] == 'RETAIN':
            assert old == new
            assert row['oldPresence'] == row['newPresence']
            assert row['oldStructuralLinks'] == row['newStructuralLinks']
            assert row['oldFacets'] == row['newFacets']
            assert row['localConstraintDelta'] == []
            preserved['localConstraints'] += 1
        if 'enum' in old:
            assert old['enum'] == new['enum']
            preserved['enums'] += 1
        if 'const' in old and p != '/properties/schemaVersion':
            assert old['const'] == new['const']
            preserved['constsExceptDeclaredVersion'] += 1
        if 'type' in old and p != '/properties/monotonic/properties/ns':
            assert old['type'] == new['type']
            preserved['typesExceptDeclaredNs'] += 1
        if old.get('additionalProperties') is False:
            assert new['additionalProperties'] is False
            preserved['closedObjects'] += 1
        for key in ('minLength', 'maxLength', 'pattern', 'format'):
            if key in old:
                assert old[key] == new[key]
                preserved['stringRules'] += 1
        for key in ('minItems', 'maxItems', 'uniqueItems'):
            if key in old:
                assert old[key] == new[key]
                preserved['arrayRules'] += 1
        if 'not' in old:
            assert old['not'] == new['not']
            preserved['inlineNotFragments'] += 1
        if 'minimum' in old and p != '/properties/monotonic/properties/ns':
            assert new['minimum'] >= old['minimum']
        if 'maximum' in old:
            assert new['maximum'] <= old['maximum']
    for p, i in expected_additions.items():
        row = by_ptr[p]
        assert row['oldConstraints'] is None and row['historicalSchemaPointer'] is None
        assert row['origin']['declaredField'] == fields['additionalFields'][i]
        assert row['origin']['fieldTable']['jsonPointer'] == '/additionalFields/' + str(i)
    assert by_ptr['/properties/schemaVersion']['newConstraints'] == {'const': '2.0.0'}
    assert by_ptr['/properties/seq']['newConstraints'] == {'type': 'integer', 'minimum': 0, 'maximum': 9007199254740991}
    assert by_ptr['/allOf/12/then/properties/payload/properties/sinceSeq']['newConstraints'] == {'type': 'integer', 'minimum': 1, 'maximum': 9007199254740991}
    assert by_ptr['/allOf/4/then/properties/payload/properties/value']['newConstraints'] == {'type': 'integer', 'minimum': -999999999, 'maximum': 999999999}
    assert by_ptr['/allOf/3/then/properties/payload/properties/confidence']['newConstraints'] == {'type': 'number', 'minimum': 0, 'maximum': 1}
    assert by_ptr['/properties/monotonic/properties/ns']['newConstraints'] == {'type': 'string', 'pattern': '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$'}
    assert by_ptr['/properties/monotonic/properties/ns']['newFacets']['string']['decimalValueRange'] == {'minimumInclusive': '0', 'maximumInclusive': '18446744073709551615', 'leadingZeroAllowedOnlyFor': '0', 'signAllowed': False}
    assert by_ptr['/properties/candidate']['newConstraints']['required'] == ['build', 'content', 'rules', 'factCatalog', 'contentDigest', 'ruleDigest']
    assert by_ptr['/properties/candidate']['newFacets']['object']['declaredFields'] == ['build', 'content', 'rules', 'factCatalog', 'contentDigest', 'ruleDigest']
    assert by_ptr['/allOf/14/then/properties/payload']['newConstraints']['required'] == ['reason']
    assert by_ptr['/allOf/14/then/properties/payload']['newPresenceCondition']['bothAllowed'] is True
    assert by_ptr['/allOf/14/then/properties/payload/properties/eventIds']['newPresence']['mode'] == 'OPTIONAL_IN_AT_LEAST_ONE_GROUP'
    node_refs = []
    citation_count = 0
    allowed_sources = {e['sourceId']: e for e in load(OWN / 'mechanics/source-before.json')['sources']}
    source_json = {}
    def scan(obj):
        nonlocal citation_count
        if isinstance(obj, list):
            for item in obj:
                scan(item)
        elif isinstance(obj, dict):
            for k, v in obj.items():
                if k.endswith('NodeId') and v is not None:
                    assert v in by_id, ('Unaufgeloester Knotenzeiger', k, v)
                    node_refs.append(v)
                elif k == 'uniqueNodeIds':
                    # Deklarierte Anzahl, kein Referenzarray; unten exakt nachgezaehlt.
                    assert isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)
                elif k.endswith('NodeIds'):
                    assert isinstance(v, list), ('Referenzliste erwartet', k, v)
                    assert all(vv in by_id for vv in v), ('Unaufgeloeste Knotenzeiger', k, v)
                    node_refs.extend(v)
                elif k == 'elementOf':
                    assert v in by_id
                    node_refs.append(v)
                scan(v)
            if 'jsonPointer' in obj or 'lines' in obj:
                path = obj['path']
                assert path in allowed_sources
                assert obj['sha256'] == allowed_sources[path]['sha256']
                if 'jsonPointer' in obj:
                    if path not in source_json:
                        source_json[path] = strict_load(ROOT / path)
                    pointer(source_json[path], obj['jsonPointer'])
                else:
                    total = len((ROOT / path).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines())
                    assert obj['lines'] and all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= total for n in obj['lines'])
                citation_count += 1
    scan(d)
    # Bedingungsarm-Dictionaries enthalten absichtlich keine globalen Selector-Ausdruecke.
    condition_links = 0
    for node in nodes:
        for key in ('oldStructuralLinks', 'newStructuralLinks'):
            links = node[key]
            if links:
                for target in links.get('conditionalArms', {}).values():
                    assert target in by_id
                    condition_links += 1
    assert not any('$ref' in pointer(history, p) for p in indexed_history)
    rep = {int(x['source']['jsonPointer'].rsplit('/', 1)[1]): x for x in d['replacementExpansion']}
    assert set(rep) == {0, 1, 2, 8, 10}
    for i, entry in rep.items():
        assert entry['sourceDeclaration'] == fields['replacements'][i]
        assert entry['explicitTargetNodeIds'] and all(t in by_id for t in entry['explicitTargetNodeIds'])
    counts = Counter(n['decision'] for n in nodes)
    computed = {'historicalSelectedNodes': len(selected), 'retainedHistoricalNodes': counts['RETAIN'],
                'replacedHistoricalNodes': counts['REPLACE'], 'declaredAdditionalFields': len(adds),
                'addedDocumentNodes': counts['ADD'],
                'derivedArrayElementNodes': sum(n['decision'] == 'ADD' and n['proposedV2Pointer'].endswith('/items') for n in nodes),
                'documentNodes': len(nodes), 'uniqueProposedPointers': len(by_ptr), 'uniqueNodeIds': len(by_id),
                'resolvedLocalNodes': sum(n['resolution'] == 'RESOLVED_IN_DECLARED_LOCAL_SCOPE' for n in nodes),
                'blockedReferenceNodes': sum(bool(n['blockerIds']) for n in nodes),
                'selectedReplacementDeclarations': len(rep)}
    assert d['counts'] == computed
    assert computed['historicalSelectedNodes'] == computed['retainedHistoricalNodes'] + computed['replacedHistoricalNodes']
    assert computed['documentNodes'] == computed['historicalSelectedNodes'] + computed['addedDocumentNodes']
    assert computed['documentNodes'] == computed['resolvedLocalNodes'] + computed['blockedReferenceNodes']
    blocked = {n['nodeId'] for n in nodes if n['blockerIds']}
    assert blocked == set(d['blockers'][0]['affectedNodeIds'])
    assert all(by_id[n]['decision'] == 'ADD' for n in blocked)
    assert all(by_id[n]['references'][0]['chosenTarget'] is None for n in blocked)
    assert d['scope']['M-HELP-TEXT-BINDING'] == 'NOT_PERFORMED_IN_THIS_SCOPE'
    assert all(v == 0 for v in d['executionBoundary'].values())
    return {
        'status': 'PASS_MECHANICAL_ONLY', 'counts': computed,
        'selectedHistoricalPointersMissing': [], 'historicalPointersDuplicated': [],
        'proposedPointerCollisions': [], 'nodeIdCollisions': [],
        'unresolvedInternalNodeReferences': [], 'remainingBlockedReferencePointers': sorted(by_id[n]['proposedV2Pointer'] for n in blocked),
        'sourceCitationAddressesChecked': citation_count, 'internalNodeReferencesChecked': len(node_refs),
        'conditionalArmReferencesChecked': condition_links,
        'preservation': preserved, 'historicalSchemaRefs': 0,
        'rootHasNoExecutableSchemaKeywords': True,
        'schemaValidationPerformed': False, 'semanticEvaluationPerformed': False,
        'scopeWarning': 'Mechanische Mengenvollstaendigkeit und lokale Dokumenterhaltung; keine semantische Richtigkeit oder Fremdfreigabe.',
    }


def finish():
    assert not (OWN / 'mechanical-checks.json').exists()
    assert not (OWN / 'handoff.json').exists()
    before = load(OWN / 'mechanics/source-before.json')
    checks = validate_documents()
    after = snapshot()
    comparison = compare(before, after)
    inputs = [owned_record(p) for p in inventory() if p != 'brief.md']
    result = {
        'documentKind': 'chnobel-event-normalform-mechanical-checks/1',
        'result': 'PASS_MECHANICAL_ONLY', 'specificationStatus': 'INCOMPLETE',
        'implementationAuthorized': False, 'wholeManifestVerdict': 'NOT_ISSUED',
        'command': 'F:/ChnobelRuntime/venv/Scripts/python.exe -B ' + (OWN / 'mechanics/check_documents.py').as_posix() + ' finish',
        'documentChecks': checks, 'sourceComparison': comparison,
        'mechanicalAttemptHistory': [
            {'attempt': 1, 'result': 'HELPER_ERROR', 'exitCode': 1,
             'helperPath': 'mechanics/check_documents.py', 'helperBytes': 20820,
             'helperSha256': '53f3e5d261e1f209d90436f862222acd3a2fe8a2ec4f87e127e4fadc3c4499f9',
             'error': "TypeError: 'int' object is not iterable",
             'location': 'validate_documents.scan, Zeile 206 des urspruenglichen Helfers',
             'cause': 'Das Zaehlerfeld uniqueNodeIds wurde aufgrund seines Namens faelschlich als Referenzarray angesprochen.',
             'outputsWrittenBeforeError': [],
             'repair': 'Anzahl explizit als Integer unterscheiden und weiterhin exakt nachzaehlen; echte NodeIds-Referenzfelder muessen Listen sein und jeden Zielknoten aufloesen. Keine Constraint-/Norm-/Quelldaten geaendert.'},
            {'attempt': 2, 'result': 'PASS_MECHANICAL_ONLY', 'documentCheckResult': checks['status']},
        ],
        'sourceBefore': before, 'sourceAfter': after,
        'artifactsReadDuringCheck': inputs,
        'sourceBindingCounts': {'manifestSources': len(after['sources']), 'indexComparisons': len(after['indexComparisons']),
                               'historicalGitBindings': len(after['historicalGitBindings']), 'immutableNormGitObjects': len(after['immutableNormSources']),
                               'mutableOrOperationalContextFiles': len(after['mutableOrOperationalContext'])},
        'nonExecutions': {'schemaValidation': 0, 'semanticProbe': 0, 'productTests': 0, 'native': 0, 'ci': 0},
    }
    write_new(OWN / 'mechanical-checks.json', result)
    output_records = [owned_record(p) for p in inventory() if p not in ('brief.md', 'handoff.json')]
    handoff = {
        'documentKind': 'chnobel-event-normalform-handoff/1', 'status': 'INCOMPLETE',
        'outputRoot': OWN.as_posix(), 'sourceRoot': ROOT.as_posix(),
        'scope': 'Nur contract=ereignis aus exaktem v2-manifest-draft-01, passende replacements und bereits deklarierte additionalFields',
        'implementationAuthorized': False, 'wholeManifestVerdict': 'NOT_ISSUED',
        'selfApproved': False, 'freezePerformed': False, 'foreignReviewPerformed': False,
        'M-FIELD-NORMALFORM': 'OPEN', 'M-HELP-TEXT-BINDING': 'NOT_PERFORMED_IN_THIS_SCOPE',
        'counts': checks['counts'], 'mechanicalResult': 'PASS_MECHANICAL_ONLY',
        'blockerIds': ['B-EVENT-DIGEST-TARGET'],
        'remainingBlockedReferencePointers': checks['remainingBlockedReferencePointers'],
        'missingHistoricalPointers': [], 'collisions': [],
        'sourceBindingsBefore': before, 'sourceBindingsAfter': after, 'sourceComparison': comparison,
        'files': output_records, 'boundOwnedFileCountExcludingSelf': len(output_records),
        'selfHashPolicy': 'handoff.json bindet alle eigenen Dateien ausser sich selbst. Sein Rohdigest wird separat in der Rueckmeldung genannt; keine rekursive Selbstbindung und keine Signatur.',
        'briefPolicy': 'brief.md ist vorhandene, unveraenderte gehashte Eingabe, keine eigene Ausgabe.',
        'exclusions': ['andere Vertraege', 'neue Hilfetextfelder', 'Falloracles', 'Gremiumsvoten', 'v2-field-supplement-01'],
        'historicalFailsOrExpectationsChanged': False,
        'repositoryWrites': 0, 'productOrSchemaImplementationWritten': False,
        'schemaOrProductTestsExecuted': 0, 'semanticEvaluationsExecuted': 0,
        'portalCiSigningUploadActions': 0, 'childrenStarted': 0, 'cronActions': 0,
        'nextStep': 'Nur fremde Sichtung dieses dokumentarischen Teilberichts; ungeklaerte Digestziele explizit binden. Andere Teilvertraege/Hilfefelder und gesamtes Manifest bleiben gesondert offen. Autor stoppt hier.',
    }
    write_new(OWN / 'handoff.json', handoff)
    return readback()


def readback():
    h = strict_load(OWN / 'handoff.json')
    m = strict_load(OWN / 'mechanical-checks.json')
    check = validate_documents()
    found = inventory()
    assert set(found) == OUTPUTS | {'brief.md'}
    assert h['boundOwnedFileCountExcludingSelf'] == len(h['files'])
    assert len({x['path'] for x in h['files']}) == len(h['files'])
    assert {x['path'] for x in h['files']} == OUTPUTS - {'handoff.json'}
    for row in h['files']:
        assert row == owned_record(row['path']), ('Ausgabedigest', row['path'])
    assert h['counts'] == check['counts'] == m['documentChecks']['counts']
    assert check == m['documentChecks']
    after = snapshot()
    comp = compare(h['sourceBindingsAfter'], after)
    assert h['status'] == 'INCOMPLETE' and h['wholeManifestVerdict'] == 'NOT_ISSUED'
    assert not h['implementationAuthorized']
    return {'result': 'PASS_MECHANICAL_READBACK_ONLY', 'specificationStatus': h['status'],
            'counts': h['counts'], 'boundOwnedFilesExcludingHandoff': len(h['files']),
            'allOwnedFiles': len(OUTPUTS), 'unchangedManifestSources': len(after['sources']),
            'lateContextChanges': comp['contextChanges'],
            'outputs': [owned_record(p) for p in sorted(OUTPUTS)],
            'noProductOrSemanticExecution': True}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    assert sys.argv[1:] in (['finish'], ['readback'])
    result = finish() if sys.argv[1:] == ['finish'] else readback()
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
